name: Ice Pack Cold Compress Time Reminder

map.冷敷计时、休息间隔、皮肤检查提醒，保障冷敷安全: Cold timing, rest intervals and skin-check reminders for safe cold therapy
map.「冷敷计时、休息间隔、皮肤检查提醒，保障冷敷安全」按输入参数进行专业计算并输出结: 'Cold timing, rest intervals and skin-check reminders for safe cold therapy' computes professional results from the inputs.
map.💡 建议单次冷敷 15-20 分钟，两次冷敷间至少休息 30 分钟，避免冻伤。每: 💡 Suggested single cold 15-20 min, rest >=30 min between, to avoid frostbite. Check local skin color and sensation every few minutes.
map.婴幼儿、老年人慎用，需缩短时间: Infants/elderly use with caution, shorten time
map.冰袋外应包裹毛巾，避免直接接触皮肤: Wrap the pack in a towel, avoid direct skin contact
map.单次冷敷不超过 20 分钟，防止冻伤: Single cold <=20 min to prevent frostbite
map.冷敷中每隔 5 分钟检查皮肤：若出现苍白、青紫、麻木应立即停止: Check skin every 5 min during cold: stop at once on pallor, cyanosis or numbness
map.冷敷后局部皮肤温度恢复前不要再次冷敷: Do not re-cold until skin temperature recovers
map.本工具纯前端运行，数据存储在浏览器本地，不会上传: This tool runs entirely in the browser; data stays local and is not uploaded
map.倒计时结束时会有声音提示，请确保浏览器未静音: A sound alerts at countdown end; ensure the browser is not muted
map.本工具仅辅助计时，不能替代专业护理判断: This tool only aids timing and cannot replace professional nursing judgment
map.冷敷过程中如出现异常，请立即停止并就医: Stop at once and seek care if anything abnormal occurs during cold
map.术后垫纱布隔离皮肤。: Post-op: pad with gauze to isolate skin.
map.输入部位=膝、单次 20min，工具给间隔 60min、每日 3 次，与医嘱一致: Input site=knee, single 20 min; tool gives 60 min interval, 3/day, matching the order.
map.冷敷计时提醒，按部位设定单次时长与间隔，预防冻伤。: Cold-timing reminder; set single duration and interval by site to prevent frostbite.
